title: Cabbage Bear in Space
description: A large anthropomorphic green bear with glowing blue and red eyes stands in a purple field, holding a transparent bubble containing a red planet and two tiny figures. The bear has leaf-like textures, a rose on its head, and geometric shapes embedded in its fur, set against a black space background with floating red planets, purple triangles, and a distant hiker.
prompt: A massive anthropomorphic green bear made of leaves and geometric shapes stands in a vast field of purple grass under a black space sky. The bear has glowing blue and red cybernetic eyes, a rose on its head, and holds a transparent bubble containing a red ringed planet with two tiny human figures inside. Floating red planets, purple triangles, and geometric patterns fill the background, with a small hiker visible in the distance.
